_note: Morphology profiles are supplied per platform, never derived from an observation. contact_pressure is kPa: platform mass distributed over the contacts in stance at the moment of loading. The same observation returns different bearing results for these profiles, which is the point (P3).

high_pressure_small_contact.note: point foot, 30 kg over two loaded contacts of 15 cm2

low_pressure_broad_contact.note: broad pad, 24 kg over two loaded contacts of 600 cm2

mid_pressure_exposed_joints.note: narrow foot on a thin ankle, no entanglement recovery: the geometry vegetation binds
